annotation.interpretation_a: The parameters must be included as part of the initial TransportParameters sent during connection establishment.
annotation.interpretation_b: The parameters can be included in any subsequent TransportParameters update after connection establishment.
annotation.justification: The clause states that the parameters "MUST" be included in "encoded TransportParameters:" but does not specify *when* these TransportParameters are sent. This allows for two reasonable interpretations: the initial handshake, or any subsequent update.
annotation.missing_information: It is unclear whether the parameters must be included only in the initial TransportParameters or can be included in any TransportParameters update.
